craft_notes: Sthāyin: commendation-joy (hanta indeed). Sanskrit first: clearance + fullness + hanta + verb → L4 keeps all uncut, ends on indeed. Rows: row 1 (indeed-last — hanta closes as indeed closes; adjudicated at L0). Rupture: dash after behind — ground done, act commended. Close: end-weight on indeed (the commendation word). Minimal pass: line break before winner (breath for the commendation). Read aloud: whole, won, indeed! (unspoken). Rejected: 'alas' — killed at L0; 'drops' for jahāti — killed: casts off kept (deliberate).

lines: His turning whole, all objects put behind —
the winner, waking-aimed: his sheath cast off, indeed.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nirastasarvārthaniraṃśavṛttir jñānī sakṛt svātmani labdhalābhaḥ / samyaṅnibodhaikaparaḥ svaniṣṭhaḥ svakañcukaṃ hanta jahāti yogī

reads_against.argmap: Turning partless, gain gained, sole aim awakening — the grounded yogin indeed abandons his sheath.
c1_essence: Turning partless, gain gained: indeed the sheath abandoned.
